description: See the mockup BEFORE creating any product — nothing is created or sold, and it costs no credits. Renders the design on the real garment (Printful) when the kind supports it (source: "printful"), otherwise a clean MU product card (source: "card"), and returns a durable preview image URL. Optionally pass `position` (front-print DTG apparel only: tee / tee_white / hoodie / crewneck / tank / long_sleeve_tee) to preview a custom print placement — passing the SAME position to mu_create_product prints exactly what you previewed (WYSIWYG). Usually answers in 10-45s; if it returns status="processing", call this tool again with the returned `preview_id` to keep waiting. Rate limit: 30 previews/hour. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

design_url.description: Absolute https URL of the design artwork (required unless preview_id is set). Use mu_upload_design first for local images.

kind.description: Product kind to preview on (required unless preview_id is set).

position.description: Optional print placement — front-print DTG apparel only (tee / tee_white / hoodie / crewneck / tank / long_sleeve_tee). The preview mockup AND the real print order use the same resolved box (WYSIWYG). Preview with mu_preview_mockup before creating.

w_pct.description: Print width as % of the printable area (20-100). 62 ≈ the default chest print.

x_pct.description: Horizontal position of the print box (0=left, 50=centered, 100=right).

y_pct.description: Vertical position of the print box (0=top/neck, 50=centered, 100=bottom/hem).

preview_id.description: Continue waiting on an earlier preview that returned status="processing".

name: mu_preview_mockup
title: Preview a product mockup (before creating)
